headline: God is with me. Why am I still alone?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see him, but your hand found the one standing openly before a full table.
He stands out in the open, with every tool visible on the table.
You said God is with you and asked why you are still alone. What catches me is the fullness already in front of this figure.
You are still alone, and your faith has not removed that question.
Something turns up just where companionship should meet your life. I don't think it started with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing showed you the figure, yet you chose the calmest man here.
He hangs upside down by one ankle. His face is calm.
You said God is with you and asked about the solitude. This card makes me look at the calm inside the pause.
Still, the companionship you want is absent while the pause continues.
There's something between you and companionship. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs gave nothing away, but your hand went to the card in full light.
The sky behind him is gold, with no cloud in it.
You said God is with you and asked why no one is beside you. The full light on this card holds my eye.
But no one has joined the road, though you said God is with you.
What has hold of the companionship question keeps it apart from the light already here. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of the question…
